title: Dentino Layer Strategy → compact maintained doc set (review · wire · QA)
description:
# Epic — Dentino Layer Strategy → compact maintained doc set (review · wire · QA)

**Stage:** layermaxxer beads conversion — *light by design for THIS project*.
**Input:** `docs/strategy/2026-06-27-dentino-layer-strategy.md` (the layer strategy — complete & coherent).
**Architectural SoT (cite, never write):** `docs/research/2026-06-16-dentino-appointment-messaging-research.md` (v2.26.3).
**Constitutional SoT:** `AGENTS.md` — RULE 3 (no real patient touched by the build).

## Why this epic is small (zero authoring beads)
The strategy doc is already complete and self-validated: its Appendix checks itself against the handoff quality bar and flags its own deliberate divergences; §5.1a maps all 24 ADRs to a primary activating layer; both front-matter pointers ALREADY EXIST (README §17–18, AGENTS.md §246–250). Per the stage's scope-calibration clause this is NOT a re-authoring stage. The real work is: per-layer coherence review, front-matter wiring verification, fold-in of any stray planmaxer/harmonymaxer notes, and a final no-sprawl QA gate — producing the *verified routing layer* the downstream code pipeline (`spec-to-strategy → spec-to-tdd → beads-from-sources`) consumes.

## Maintained-doc set (NON-NEGOTIABLE — the only md paths any child bead may write)
1. `docs/strategy/2026-06-27-dentino-layer-strategy.md` — THE strategy doc. The index/navigation (layer → research §ref → CI tier → §11 slice) lives INSIDE it: the §1 table + the §4.3 CI matrix + the per-layer §3.N.7 DoD rows. **No separate index file.**
2. `README.md` — one-line pointer (already present; verify/maintain only).
3. `AGENTS.md` — one-line pointer under "Key Source of Truth" (already present; verify/maintain only).
- `docs/research/2026-06-16-dentino-appointment-messaging-research.md` is a **read/cite source only** — no child bead may write it.

## Authority split
- **Strategy owns:** rollout order · layer boundaries · the invariant-activation sequence · the build-shippable-vs-go-live distinction · the per-layer DoD/CI-gate mapping.
- **Research owns:** execution-grade architecture (data model §5.3, concurrency SQL §5.7, ADRs §7, test catalog §6.5). The strategy cites into it; never copies it.

## Path-ownership hard rule (binds every child)
No child bead may create/own a markdown path outside the maintained set — no companion docs, cross-layer ledgers, per-layer spec files, or a separate index. Open questions live inside the strategy §7 under the owning layer. No child bead modifies the research doc, and **no child bead builds `clinic_id`/multi-tenant scaffolding** (explicit non-goal, ADR-017 / research §2.5).

## Live-clinic guardrail (RULE 3 / ADR-024)
Beads tagged `live-clinic-side-effect` review sections describing real-capable side effects (`smsSender`, the guarded write-back, the go-live ladder). No bead's output may read as "turn sends on" / "make writes live" — only the human-authorized research §6.6 ladder does that, as a post-L4 runtime event.

## Review discipline (binds EVERY review/deepen/fold child — anti-drift contract)
The gates exist to *verify*, not to grow the doc. Each doc-editing child is bound by:
1. **Additive precision only** — may add a §ref/ADR citation or sharpen wording; may NEVER remove, soften, or genericize a stated invariant, DoD row, atomic unit, or guardrail.
2. **Cite, never restate** — "deepen if thin" = add the MISSING citation + a one-line summary; NEVER copy the research doc's SQL / RPC bodies / test catalog / execution-grade prose into the strategy doc (Execution Artifact Policy: execution detail is "cited, not restated"; duplication is THE documented drift hazard).
3. **Anti-accretion** — default outcome is "coherent, no change"; any edit is surgical and in-place; add no new subsection/heading/file/prose block; the doc must not grow materially.
4. **The three atomic units stay whole in L1** — token-mint⊗send-claim⊗render; the full Cancel flow; mode-flag⊗chokepoint⊗allowlist (strategy Appendix line 441); no gate may split one across beads or sub-layers.

## Success Criteria
- All child beads either pass unchanged or make only surgical in-place edits within the maintained write set: the strategy doc, `README.md`, and `AGENTS.md`.
- No child creates a new markdown artifact, writes the research doc, relaxes a day-1 invariant, frames the go-live ladder as a build layer, or builds `clinic_id`/multi-tenant scaffolding.
- The final QA gate proves all 24 ADRs are placed or explicitly deferred, the layer-to-CI map is coherent, and coverage gaps are zero.

## Children
front-matter verify/fix · L1/L2/L3/L4 per-layer coherence-review gates (review-only) · deferred-work coverage check · planmaxer/harmonymaxer fold-in check · cross-layer coherence review · final compact-doc QA gate (closes the epic).

description:

title: Fold-in check — planmaxer/harmonymaxer notes for unabsorbed layer material
description:

## Review discipline (binding — this gate must not itself become a drift vector)

- **Anti-accretion / anti-sprawl.** Default outcome is "nothing unabsorbed — no change." Any fold is surgical (a clause/citation in place); add NO new subsection, heading, file, or prose block. The doc must not grow materially; no new markdown path may be created.

title: L1 coherence-review gate — Hermetic Guarded Loop (§3.1)
description:
## Background
Review-only gate over strategy **§3.1 (Layer L1 — Hermetic Guarded Loop)**. **Do NOT re-author** — §3.1 is already written (sub-sections 3.1.1–3.1.13). Verify coherence and *deepen only if a sub-section is found thin* against the day-1 invariant set + the §6.5 CI-tier map. Writes nothing unless a thinness fix is needed, in which case it edits **only §3.1 of the strategy doc**.

## Current-state context
§3.1 is the XL root layer: the complete daily cycle running hermetically in dry-run with every day-1 invariant active as shipped. It folds research §11 slices 1–4. Tagged `live-clinic-side-effect` because the two real-capable chokepoints (`smsSender`, the guarded write-back) FIRST EXIST here.

## Target behavior — verify ALL of:
1. **Day-1 invariant set intact in §3.1.5** — all 10 of §5.1 are marked DAY-1: hermetic no-egress (ADR-023); fail-closed `SEND_MODE`/`CRM_WRITE_MODE` + allowlist at BOTH chokepoints (ADR-024); the FULL capability-flow Cancel incl. the write-halting velocity breaker (ADR-014); privilege-boundary core (ADR-019); DB-enforced single-use I1 (CAS + `one_action_requires_lock` CHECK + `reminder_messages_action_lock_guard` trigger, all in `0001`); always-materialize + `crm_visit_facts` (research §5.6); `appointment_fingerprint` + supersede-kills-token I3 (ADR-008); token-mint⊗send-claim⊗render atomic (research §5.7b); fenced side effects (ADR-020); Kyiv date math + determinism seams (research §4.4); no-phone-persistence + redact-at-write (ADR-016).
2. **Atomic units un-split — ALL THREE per the strategy Appendix (line 441).** §3.1 must keep each as ONE unit, never "build now / harden later": (i) token-mint⊗send-claim⊗render = one unit in `run-reminders`; (ii) the full Cancel flow (side-effect-free GET/HEAD ⊗ nonce POST ⊗ single-use CAS ⊗ interstitial ⊗ breaker) = one unit in `confirm`; (iii) **mode-flag⊗chokepoint⊗allowlist** — `SEND_MODE`+send-allowlist ship in the SAME work package as `smsSender`, and `CRM_WRITE_MODE`+write-allowlist in the SAME work package as the guarded write-back (§6 claim-gate 2). No chokepoint may exist without its guard. §3.1 must not decompose any of the three across sub-layers (§6 claim-order gates 2–3).
3. **Chokepoints ship fail-closed from creation** — §3.1.6 must keep `smsSender` as the STUB at runtime (`SEND_MODE='off'`) with the real provider code built + cassette-tested but reachable only via the go-live seed-rung flip; the guarded write-back ships with `CRM_WRITE_MODE` off. No "happy-path-first, harden-later."
4. **Cross-day-move build-gate placed here** (§3.1.13 / research §10 Q4): absent a visit-by-id lookup, v1 kills the old token + flags staff, never auto-sends a cross-day notice.
5. **ADR coverage matches §5.1a** for L1-primary ADRs (001, 004, 005, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, 014, 015, 016, 019, 020, 022, 023, 024) and the scaffolded-here/activated-later notes (I2 code reapers here, `pg_cron` backstop → L2).
6. **DoD cites §6.5 correctly** — smoke Rungs A/B/C + CI tiers 0,1,2,3,4,5, the single-firing reconciliation-shortfall subset of tier 6 (◑), and 7 — proven by the no-egress assertion, NOT a real SMS.

## Architectural detail (by citation)
Strategy §3.1, §5.1, §5.1a, §5.1b, §6 (claim-order gates 1–4); research §5.2, §5.3, §5.6, §5.7a–d, §5.8, §6.3.1/.2, §6.5 rows 1–4, §10 Q1–Q6; ADR-008/012/014/019/020/023/024.

## Dependencies
Blocked by the fold-in check (review the final §3.1 text). Independent of L2/L3/L4 reviews (run in parallel).

## Verification (Step-6 style)
Reviewer confirms: every §5.1 item appears DAY-1 in §3.1.5; none of the three atomic units is split; both chokepoints are off-by-default from creation; the Q4 build-gate is in §3.1.13; the DoD reads as no-egress-assertion-not-real-SMS. Any gap → deepen §3.1 in place (no new file); else record "coherent, no change."

## Acceptance criteria
§3.1 passes all six checks; if edited, only §3.1 of the strategy doc changed; live-clinic guardrail intact (no wording that turns a real send/write on).

## Review discipline (binding — this gate must not itself become a drift vector)
- **Additive precision only.** May add a §ref/ADR citation or sharpen wording; may NEVER remove, soften, or genericize a stated invariant, DoD row, atomic unit, or guardrail. Lost precision = a FAILED gate.
- **Cite, never restate (anti-duplication).** "Deepen if thin" = add the MISSING research §ref / ADR pointer + a one-line summary — NEVER copy research-doc SQL, RPC bodies, the test catalog, or execution-grade prose into the strategy doc (strategy §3 intro + Execution Artifact Policy: execution detail is "cited, not restated"; duplication is THE documented drift hazard).
- **Anti-accretion / anti-sprawl.** Expected outcome is "coherent — no change." Any edit is surgical (a clause/citation in place); add NO new subsection, heading, file, or prose block. The doc must not grow materially; no new markdown path may be created.

## Fresh-eyes coverage checklist (binding)
When executing this L1 gate, explicitly tick the named surfaces below in §3.1; do not treat the research citations as a substitute for checking the strategy text.

- **Components/shared modules L1 owns:** `run-reminders/index.ts`, `confirm/index.ts`, `_shared/clinicCardsClient.ts`, `_shared/smsSender.ts`, the guarded write-back path, `_shared/http.ts`, `_shared/clock.ts`, `_shared/tokens.ts`, `_shared/sender.ts`, `_shared/templates.ts`, `_shared/phone.ts`, `_shared/db.ts`.
- **All 13 app-schema base tables are created in L1's schema freeze:** `patients`, `reminder_runs`, `reminder_days`, `reminder_messages`, `message_templates`, `inbound_events`, `audit_log`, `consent_events`, `cancellation_circuits`, `crm_visit_write_locks`, `cliniccards_status_policy`, `crm_fetch_log`, `crm_visit_facts`. L1 may activate only the subset stated in §3.1.3, but the graph must not leave any base table to a later v1 layer.
- **DB-enforced invariants checked here:** the two partial-unique idempotency indexes, `one_action_requires_lock`, `claimed_or_live_token_required`, `reminder_messages_action_lock_guard`, and `message_templates_one_active`.
- **Public confirm boundary checked here:** `dentino_confirm_api` gets only the four `api` RPCs `lookup_reminder_by_token`, `prepare_reminder_action`, `record_reminder_action`, `finish_reminder_action`; the public confirm function never receives `service_role`.
- **Live-clinic invariant check:** `smsSender` is never mode-less, the guarded write-back is never mode-less, both include the fail-closed mode flag plus allowlist from creation, and `GET`/`HEAD` remain side-effect-free. If §3.1 suggests a temporary relaxation, the bead fails.

title: L2 coherence-review gate — Reliability Spine & Proof-of-Run (§3.2)
description:
## Background
Review-only gate over strategy **§3.2 (Layer L2 — Reliability Spine & Proof-of-Run)**. Do NOT re-author; verify-and-deepen-if-thin; edits (if any) touch **only §3.2**.

## Current-state context
L2 turns L1's correct-but-manually-invoked loop into a self-healing, self-proving, scheduled, unattended service (research §11 slice 6). Still hermetic — sends stay stubbed.

## Target behavior — verify:
1. **No new real-capable side effect** (§3.2.13) — sends/writes stay off; L2 only ADDS reaper-totality + proof-of-run. L2 must NOT be framed as a go-live rung.
2. **I2 totality completed via the `pg_cron` backstop** (§3.2.5 / ADR-018) — "every non-terminal status has an automated exit even with zero future Edge firings"; plus the `pg_cron` sweep of the fenced CRM-write reaper (ADR-020). The "I2 scaffolded in L1, activated in L2" framing must be consistent with §3.1.10 and §5.1b.
3. **The three-reaper totality is a complete set** — next-firing + on-steal (L1 code) + `pg_cron` backstop (L2 schedule).
4. **Dead-man's-switch** (ADR-013) — success ping only on green/amber; a silent miss pages a human by 12:30 Kyiv; ping-delivery is not run-state.
5. **Heartbeat-grace lease steal proven** (≈120 s recovery, not the 15-min TTL) on a frozen-then-advanced `app.test_now` clock; a holder renewing ≤30 s is never stolen.
6. **DLR webhook correctly marked optional / most-deferrable** — gated by research §10 Q5 (per-message DLR confirmation); `sent ≠ delivered` and I4 promotes `send_unknown→delivered` via the patient action, so it may slip to L4 without harming the spine.
7. **DoD** = CI tier 2 (Rung-B steal) + tier 6 (totality + steal + reconciliation red-state + heartbeat-NOT-pinged) + tier 4 (dry-run still green through catch-up). Schema-freeze honored (§4.1): L2 adds the `pg_cron` *schedule* + optional DLR surface, no base-table column change.

## Architectural detail (by citation)
Strategy §3.2, §4.1, §4.3 (L2 column), §5.1b, §5.2; research §5.7a, §6.5 row 6, §6.6; ADR-003/006/012/013/018/020.

## Dependencies
Blocked by the fold-in check. Parallel with L1/L3/L4 reviews.

## Verification
Confirm L2 adds zero real side effect; I2-totality + the 3-reaper set + the dead-man's-switch + heartbeat-grace steal are all present and consistent with §5.1b; DLR is optional; the DoD cites the right tiers. Gap → deepen §3.2 in place; else "coherent."

## Acceptance criteria
§3.2 passes; any edit confined to §3.2; the build-vs-go-live line intact (L2 is not a go-live rung).

## Review discipline (binding — this gate must not itself become a drift vector)
- **Additive precision only.** May add a §ref/ADR citation or sharpen wording; may NEVER remove, soften, or genericize a stated invariant, DoD row, atomic unit, or guardrail. Lost precision = a FAILED gate.
- **Cite, never restate (anti-duplication).** "Deepen if thin" = add the MISSING research §ref / ADR pointer + a one-line summary — NEVER copy research-doc SQL, RPC bodies, the test catalog, or execution-grade prose into the strategy doc (strategy §3 intro + Execution Artifact Policy: execution detail is "cited, not restated"; duplication is THE documented drift hazard).
- **Anti-accretion / anti-sprawl.** Expected outcome is "coherent — no change." Any edit is surgical (a clause/citation in place); add NO new subsection, heading, file, or prose block. The doc must not grow materially; no new markdown path may be created.

## Fresh-eyes coverage checklist (binding)
When executing this L2 gate, explicitly tick these reliability surfaces in §3.2; do not infer them only from ADR names.

- **Operational components L2 owns:** the Kyiv-gated multi-fire scheduler, the afternoon catch-up, heartbeat-renewal/heartbeat-grace steal exercise, the external dead-man's-switch start/fail/success pings, `GET /healthz`, `maintenance.reap_stale_sends()` scheduled via `pg_cron`, the `pg_cron` CRM-write reaper sweep, and the optional `sms-status/index.ts` DLR webhook if the provider confirmation exists.
- **Three-reaper totality must be explicit and complete:** next-firing reaper + on-steal sweep + `pg_cron` backstop. A bead output that leaves `sending` recoverable only by a future Edge firing is not ready.
- **Tables/surfaces L2 activates without base-table schema change:** `reminder_days` full lease/reconciliation rollup, `reminder_runs.pass_kind='catchup'`, `crm_visit_facts` pinned denominator use, and optional `inbound_events` ingestion for DLR. L2 may add schedules/functions/endpoints, not v1 base-table columns/CHECKs/indexes.
- **No-go-live framing check:** L2 is not `shadow`, `seed`, `canary`, or `full`; it is still hermetic and only proves unattended reliability. Any wording that makes L2 a go-live rung fails the bead.

title: L3 coherence-review gate — Operations Surface (§3.3)
description:
## Background
Review-only gate over strategy **§3.3 (Layer L3 — Operations Surface)**. Do NOT re-author; deepen-if-thin; edits touch **only §3.3**.

L3 is the single authenticated dashboard (research §11 slice 5): status board, 4-number trust panel, value panel, needs-attention, held-cancel resolution, template editor, current-mode banner, "Message next day" button. ## Target behavior — verify:
1. **Privilege boundary CONSUMED, not relaxed** (§3.3.3/.5 / ADR-019) — staff read ONLY via `api.v_board` / `api.v_needs_attention` `security_invoker` views (no token/nonce/claim digests); writes ONLY through audited `SECURITY DEFINER` admin RPCs (`update_message_template` / `resolve_held_cancels` / `reenable_sms_reminders`). `authenticated` holds NO base-table grants (set in L1). 6. **DoD** = research §6.5 row 5 (Rung A trust-panel rollup math + Playwright dashboard regression + axe-AA) → CI tier 5; plus the pgTAP least-privilege assertion extended to the new views/RPCs.

## Architectural detail (by citation)

## Dependencies
Blocked by the fold-in check. Parallel with L1/L2/L4 reviews.

## Verification
Confirm staff never reach base tables; the views/RPCs are additive; the current-mode banner is present; the status-board ∥ L2 / trust-panel ⟂ L2 seam is stated; the DoD cites tier 5. Gap → deepen §3.3 in place; else "coherent."

## Acceptance criteria
§3.3 passes; any edit confined to §3.3; no relaxed invariant; no real-capable side effect introduced.

## Review discipline (binding — this gate must not itself become a drift vector)
- **Additive precision only.** May add a §ref/ADR citation or sharpen wording; may NEVER remove, soften, or genericize a stated invariant, DoD row, atomic unit, or guardrail. Lost precision = a FAILED gate.
- **Cite, never restate (anti-duplication).** "Deepen if thin" = add the MISSING research §ref / ADR pointer + a one-line summary — NEVER copy research-doc SQL, RPC bodies, the test catalog, or execution-grade prose into the strategy doc (strategy §3 intro + Execution Artifact Policy: execution detail is "cited, not restated"; duplication is THE documented drift hazard).
- **Anti-accretion / anti-sprawl.** Expected outcome is "coherent — no change." Any edit is surgical (a clause/citation in place); add NO new subsection, heading, file, or prose block. The doc must not grow materially; no new markdown path may be created.

## Fresh-eyes coverage checklist (binding)
When executing this L3 gate, explicitly tick these operations-surface items in §3.3.

- **Dashboard components L3 owns:** `apps/dashboard/*` status board, needs-attention view, template editor, 4-number trust panel, value panel, held-cancel resolution, current-mode banner, and the staff-facing "Message next day" trigger for L1's `POST /run-reminders`.
- **Read/write boundary:** staff reads go only through `api.v_board` and `api.v_needs_attention` `security_invoker` views; staff writes go only through audited admin RPCs `update_message_template`, `resolve_held_cancels`, and `reenable_sms_reminders`. `authenticated` receives no base-table grants and no token/nonce/claim digest projection.

title: L4 coherence-review gate — Hardening & Go-Live Readiness (§3.4)
description:
## Background
Review-only gate over strategy **§3.4 (Layer L4 — Hardening & Go-Live Readiness)**. Do NOT re-author; deepen-if-thin; edits touch **only §3.4**. Tagged `live-clinic-side-effect` because L4 ships the go-live ladder's operational MECHANICS (audit, typed-confirm-token, guard-liveness) — but NOT the ladder itself.

## Current-state context
L4 is the last build layer (research §11 slice 7 + §6.6): retention purge, balance/low-balance alerts, breaker calibration, failure-injection completeness, and the go-live operational scaffolding. After L4 the build is complete and go-live-READY.

## Target behavior — verify:
1. **L4 must NOT flip a mode to `full`** (§3.4.13 / RULE 3 / your-tasks D1b) — turning any real send/write on is the human-authorized post-L4 runtime act, never L4 build work. The section must not read as "turn sends/writes on."
2. **Go-live ladder represented as a RUNTIME EVENT, not a build layer** — §3.4 ships the *mechanics* (mode-flip → `audit_log` row; the one-time typed-confirmation token gating the first real write; the scheduled guard-liveness check asserting the allowlist guard is active + non-empty in non-`full` rungs). 3. **Retention purge deferred safely** (§3.4.5 / ADR-016) — the MINIMIZATION invariant (redact-at-write) was day-1 in L1, so no full phone is ever persisted; the scheduled `maintenance.purge_privacy()` is belt-and-suspenders.
4. **Breaker CALIBRATION only** here — the breaker MECHANISM (write-halting velocity hard-open) shipped in L1; L4 only tunes thresholds + the two-level daily anomaly, then re-validates (a flu-day distribution must not false-trip).
5. **Security go-live gate** (research §6.5 release gate) authored incrementally across L1–L4, **green before production** — incl. the research §6.6 guard tests (non-allowlisted send/write refused with zero provider/`PUT` calls; empty allowlist refuses all; only `full` lifts it; `full` under `APP_ENV∈{test,dev}` hard-fails at boot).
6. **DoD** = CI tier 6 (the complete failure-injection matrix + breaker velocity/drip) + the security go-live gate green. No base-table schema change (§4.1).

## Architectural detail (by citation)
Strategy §3.4, §4.1, §4.3 (L4 column + security-go-live-gate row), §4.4, §4.5; research §6.5 row 7 + the security go-live gate, §6.6, §4.5 retention; ADR-003/014/016/017/024.

## Dependencies
Blocked by the fold-in check. Parallel with L1/L2/L3 reviews.

## Verification
Confirm §3.4 never flips a mode to `full`; the ladder is mechanics-here / rollout-in-§4.5; the purge is belt-and-suspenders; only calibration is L4; the security go-live gate + §6.6 guard tests are the pre-go-live proof; the DoD cites tier 6 + the release gate. Gap → deepen §3.4 in place; else "coherent."

## Acceptance criteria
§3.4 passes; any edit confined to §3.4; live-clinic guardrail intact (no "turn on real sends/writes" wording; only the human ladder does that).

## Review discipline (binding — this gate must not itself become a drift vector)
- **Additive precision only.** May add a §ref/ADR citation or sharpen wording; may NEVER remove, soften, or genericize a stated invariant, DoD row, atomic unit, or guardrail. Lost precision = a FAILED gate.
- **Cite, never restate (anti-duplication).** "Deepen if thin" = add the MISSING research §ref / ADR pointer + a one-line summary — NEVER copy research-doc SQL, RPC bodies, the test catalog, or execution-grade prose into the strategy doc (strategy §3 intro + Execution Artifact Policy: execution detail is "cited, not restated"; duplication is THE documented drift hazard).
- **Anti-accretion / anti-sprawl.** Expected outcome is "coherent — no change." Any edit is surgical (a clause/citation in place); add NO new subsection, heading, file, or prose block. The doc must not grow materially; no new markdown path may be created.

## Fresh-eyes coverage checklist (binding)
When executing this L4 gate, explicitly tick these hardening/go-live-readiness surfaces in §3.4.

- **Hardening components L4 owns:** `maintenance.purge_privacy()` scheduled via `pg_cron`, SMS balance/quota and low-balance alerting through `smsSender`, breaker threshold calibration and velocity-vs-drip proof, full failure-injection coverage, audited mode-flip mechanics, the one-time typed-confirmation token for the first real write, and scheduled guard-liveness checks.
- **Safety-gate tests must stay explicit:** non-allowlisted send/write refused with zero provider/`PUT` calls; empty allowlist refuses all; only `full` lifts the allowlist; `full` under `APP_ENV in {test,dev}` hard-fails at boot; `GET`/`HEAD` still cause zero business writes.

- **Runtime rollout boundary:** L4 makes the build go-live-ready. It does not advance to `shadow`, `seed`, `canary`, or `full`, does not flip a mode, and does not make a first real send/write. Those are human-authorized post-L4 runtime acts.
